subject: prd/existing-repo-onboarding
statement: When the adopt verb is run in plan mode against a non-empty repository, the system shall inspect the tree and produce a durable adoption plan without modifying any tracked file.
rationale: the negotiation begins by reading, not writing (D-1, D-6)
fit_criterion: on the fixture repo, plan mode writes only the plan artifact; every other tracked path is byte-identical before and after
